==Usage==
<pre>{{Top|}}
{{Movie
|image=
|title=
|director=
|producer=
|production company=
|writer=
|starring=
|music=
|release date=
|runtime=
|budget=
|language=
|timeline=
|series=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}
</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|image}} Use the film's theatrical poster
*{{Para|title}} Use the official title of the film
*{{Para|director}} Include the names of the director(s)
*{{Para|producer}} Include the names of the producer(s)
*{{Para|production company}} Include the name of the production company
*{{Para|writer}} Include the names of the writer(s)
*{{Para|starring}} Include a bulleted list of the starring actors
*{{Para|music}} Include the names of the composer(s)
*{{Para|release date}} Include the date on which the film was released
*{{Para|runtime}} Include the runtime of the film
*{{Para|budget}} Include the film's budget
*{{Para|language}} Include the primary langue the film was released in
*{{Para|timeline}} Specify when in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' timeline the events of the main story occurs using the [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY/ABY system]]. Use <code>c.</code> if approximate dates are used. For films that are part of both continuities, this field should be replaced by:
**{{Para|canon_timeline}} The chronological placement of the film in the [[canon]] continuity
**{{Para|legends_timeline}} The chronological placement of the film in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity
*{{Para|series}} Include the series the film may be part of.
*{{Para|preceded by}} Include the preceding film in the series.
*{{Para|followed by}} Include the subsequent film in the series.
